text: Meet Departures: split-flap boards for any small business.
Café menus and price lists. Type anything, and every letter drops into its own flap.
Queues at the barber, or the pharmacy.
Even a welcome screen for holiday rentals.
Every layer has a name, so you can update it by chat, through the SVGator MCP.
Departures. A template family for SVGator.
